Text: I've had the pleasure of working with Kiran at Haleon, and to say he’s been an asset would be an understatement.  What truly sets Kiran apart is his ability to connect the dots (priceless in dynamic environments), find ways to fill the informational gaps and combine technical expertise and business domain. You can trust him to get things done without micromanagement; he thrives on autonomy and consistently delivers results, which for me was always a key.  You can count on Kiran, no matter the challenge. I wholeheartedly recommend him for any role that demands expertise, reliability, and a forward-thinking approach. He’s a true standout in many-many ways.

We met with Stuart when he was already in charge of the biggest program at GSK, yet his awareness of scope, schedule and budget was remarkably solid. There are few tech people who are comfortable with finance and Stuart is one of them, which made our cooperation efficient and frutefull.   Despite the complexities of leading global initiatives, Stuart always find time to provide the data needed, educate stakeholders where necessary and staying focus on the result rather than pursuing own agenda. In a very rigid corporate world, Stuart stays loyal to agile ways of working.

Lukasz has probably the most developed soft skills, from all the people I have ever faced at Luxoft. His ability to find common ground is remarkable and ability to listen and build dialog is exceptional.    On top of his expertise in the filed, he doesn't blow his own trumpet but shares his knowledge as a good mentor. If Lukasz is your manager, you can be sure your personal development will be one of his top priorities.

I met Sergiusz in 2019 and his approach of handling candidates positively bewildered me. Nowadays you rarely come across someone who can appreciate skill without undue fluttery or worse neglecting it.  Sergiusz is able clearly delineate recruitment process, manage expectations and provide constructive feedback without damaging your self-esteem. Those who will work with Sergiusz will be fond of his competencies.

During transition of controlling function from Germany to Poland, Agata was a pioneer in documenting comprehensive R2R processes and had to enter “uncharted waters” of process redesign.  She was always very independent and required little to none supervision, which was helpful considering the size of the team.  Agata is fun to work with and anyone who will have her by their side, will have a knowledgeable, hardworking, and positive teammate.

Never in my life I met a recruiter who would be treating candidate like he/she is a his/her sibling or a good friend who is in urgent need to find a job so he/she feels that is a question of absolute importance and honour to get candidate an offer. Never in my life, until I met Kasia. She is unique in her abilities to build relationship with candidates and her degree of care is overwhelming. I score Kasia with 10 out of 10 and any candidate under her supervision is in good hands.

Our collaboration with Mia from start bypassed “storming” phase and we went straight to “performing”. It is rarely you manage to make communication effective when there is no proximity but Mia’s approach to organizing tasks and presenting materials led to productive calls during COVID-19 pandemic. Those who have Mia in their team will have a responsible, diligent, ethical and reliable team mate. I am glad to be in the same team with her.

Back in 2017 Fujitsu was doing transition of finance functions from EMEIA region to Poland, it was organized and supervised by Yasser.   Thanks to his knowledge of project management and couching skills, I learnt a great deal of PM techniques and managed to performed transition of controlling function from Germany without loss of quality and with no impact on operations.  He has remarkable attitude to customers and stakeholders which contributed to his reputation as a customer and business oriented person with focus on solution.  I am thankful to Yasser for his guidance and couching during our work on a number of business and CSR projects. He really knows what he is doing and he is doing it well.

I frequently visit HR team with all sort of issues (good and bad, personal and as a TL). Anna manages not to forward me to someone else if it is “not her thing” but takes ownership over the request, which I appreciate a lot.  She comes back with a follow up rather fast and knows how to get things done (which form, which person).

Job Title: Senior FP&A analyst & Team coordinator - Central Functions
Text: Szymon was by my side when I took over HQ function and no surprise, despite being junior at that time, he was the one who explained me a lot of things about HQ in first place.   One year passed, he is still by my side but as a specialist, with more scope, more understanding about business functions and still making sure things get done whatever the circumstances.  Whoever will work with Szymon in the future, will have a loyal, smart and generally good human being by his/her side”.

When I was hesitant to incorporate my first company back in 2011, because statutory reporting and dealing with HMRC is not my thing, I asked Matthew, who was my teacher and later became life long friend, an advice on dealing with tax bureaucracy. What he told me was: “It’s easy”. Few meetings and things were sorted, for which I am grateful to Matthew as a friend and entrepreneur.

Radek was a great companion during our transition journey from Germany to Poland. He managed to cover his operational work with top quality, participate in numerous projects, being a member of VBA community, organize team outings, competing in half marathons  and all that without damage to his life work balance (I hope).

Natalia is a person who helped securing knowledge for three different teams after transition from Germany to Poland. She was the one who was education team mates about standard operating procedures, format, what content should look like, and impact of context. On her account over 100 instructions, reviewed and approved. This gave her a recognition as a very logical, sequential and pragmatic specialist.

Magda is full of enthusiasm and accomplished specialist in various areas, you name it - project management, management accounting, process design. During our work at Fujitsu she proved herself as a quick and capable learner (Visio, MS Project) and reliable subordinate and partner in projects we accomplished together (such as implementation of internal controls, transformation of HQ function team). Anyone who has Magda in his or her team will get things covered.

Sylwia was a great support during transition period from Germany to Poland. She greatly contributed to building a team which eventually showed high quality of work, zero attrition and low level of direct control over activities. Her hard and soft skills will complement any project or team she is part of.

Alexander has been a great help to me when I faced non-existent system of financial reporting, financial planning and internal control procedures. He is knowledgeable about various areas of finance and equipped with tools (such as advanced knowledge of Excel and PowerPoint) to implement the ideas.     We successfully accomplished quite a number of projects together and his dedication to the cause is remarkable. Anyone who works or ever will work with Oleksandr has a professional on his/her team.

Juliana can be proudly called a truly proper student. Always on time, always prepared and full of professionally mean questions. Having this kind of students gives a sense of importance when you see the "hunger" with which they absorb the information during the lecture.
